summary: Browser extension and desktop app that uses an LLM to translate, polish or summarize selected text in 55 languages.

heroCommands.command: Get the Windows or macOS build from the latest release

sixtySeconds.whatItDoes: NextAI Translator (formerly OpenAI Translator) is a translation tool powered by large language models. Select text in your browser or on your desktop to translate it, polish its wording, or summarize it, across 55 languages. It streams results, reads text aloud, translates screenshots and keeps a vocabulary book. It works with OpenAI, Azure OpenAI Service, MiniMax and other LLM providers using your own API key.
sixtySeconds.problem: Switching to a separate translation site breaks your flow. This brings LLM-quality translation and rewriting to any text you select.
whoFor: People reading or writing in other languages
Anyone who wants quick text polishing
sixtySeconds.whyChoose: Pick it for one tool across browsers and desktop that translates, polishes and summarizes with the LLM provider you choose.
requirements: An API key from a supported LLM provider such as OpenAI or Azure OpenAI

overview: Get an API key from a supported provider, such as OpenAI or Azure OpenAI Service.
Install the browser extension from your browser's store, or download the desktop app from the latest GitHub release.
Enter your API key in the settings and select text to translate. It is licensed AGPL-3.0.

troubleshooting.problem: macOS says the developer cannot be verified
troubleshooting.solution: Open Settings, Privacy and Security, and click Open Anyway, or remove the quarantine flag with the xattr command.
Remove and re-add NextAI Translator under Privacy and Security in macOS settings.
